card.name: Quantity words before a drug or solution
card.fires_on: Quantity words such as some, any, excess, additional, remaining and all that come just before a noun for a drug, solution or contents. They appear in instructions about giving, sharing, discarding or using up product.

modes.description: Words like any, all or some that stand before the drug or solution being handled, wasted or shared.
modes.example: Do not waste<< any>> infusion solution during the priming process.
